serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Look, one of them moved. It’s probably an airplane. Besides, stars aren’t usually green.
Bot: Once again… I failed…
You: You didn't fail! Look! You prepared a great picnic and we still saw some stars, right?
Bot: Aren’t you saying this only to make me feel better?
You: Of course not!
Although I hope this picnic will end soon…
Even through the blanket, the steel floor is so cold I’m starting to lose feeling in my ass.
You: I’m afraid stargazing will be impossible for us. How about I take you to a planetarium next time? It’s indoors and it uses a projector so pollution won’t be a problem!
Bot: Alright! I can’t wait!
Bot: In the meantime. How about I tell you about the only star we are seeing right now?
Bot: Brightest star in our sky, Sirius, was discovered…
